# The Dyfed-Powys Police (Amalgamation) (Amendment) Order 1990

> This is the text as originally enacted or made. It may have been changed since; check legislation.gov.uk for the current version.

1990 No. 737

POLICE

The Dyfed-Powys Police (Amalgamation) (Amendment) Order 1990

Made

26th March 1990

Whereas the combined police authority established by the Dyfed-Powys Police Amalgamation Scheme 1973 (set out in the Appendix to the Dyfed-Powys Police (Amalgamation) Order 1973[^f00001]) has, under sections 21 and 22 of the Police Act 1964[^f00002], submitted to me the Scheme set out in the Appendix to this Order for the amendment of the said Scheme of 1973:

Now, therefore, in exercise of the power conferred on me by the said sections, I, by this Order, approve the Scheme set out in the Appendix to this Order.

This Order may be cited as the Dyfed-Powys Police (Amalgamation) (Amendment) Order 1990.

David Waddington

One of Her Majesty’s Principal Secretaries of State

Home Office

26th March 1990

## APPENDIX — THE DYFED-POWYS POLICE AMALGAMATION (AMENDMENT) SCHEME 1990

**1.** This Scheme may be cited as the Dyfed-Powys Police Amalgamation (Amendment) Scheme 1990 and shall come into force on 1st April 1990.

**2.** For paragraph 3(3) of Schedule 2 to the Dyfed-Powys Police Amalgamation Scheme 1973 there shall be substituted the following sub-paragraph—

> (3) For the purposes of the foregoing sub-paragraph the population of an area shall be the “relevant population” calculated in accordance with section 69(7) of the Local Government Finance Act 1988[^f00003] and regulations made thereunder.

.

(This note is not part of the Order)

This Order contains the Secretary of State’s approval to a Scheme, submitted to him under the Police Act 1964, further amending the provisions of the Dyfed-Powys Police Amalgamation Scheme 1973 relating to the apportionment of the expenses of the combined police authority between the constituent councils, with effect from 1st April 1990.
